data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 7.2m (2017: GBP 20.9m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2018 year end Syndicate 510 carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,548.7m at the start of the year. During the calendar year there was a modest net favourable prioryears development: a reported surplus of GBP 7.2m relating to reassessment of prior accident years (net of reinsurance), which we have used as the quantified prior year movement (gross figure not explicitly stated). The release reflects favourable claims development across the portfolio, particularly within Property & Special Lines, although 2018 itself experienced several significant catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Florence and Michael and major California wildfires) which impacted the annual result.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 7.2m (2017: GBP 20.9m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
The 2016 underwriting year result was significantly improved by the back years' release of GBP 54.6m as a result of favourable claims development on prior years
reserve improvements on earlier years, notably in respect of the 2001 World Trade Centre attacks, have offset these and produced a positive result for the division
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding obtained from the 2018 balance sheet liabilities (prior year comparative). No explicit GROSS prioryears movement figure was located in the notes; the report explicitly states a NET surplus of GBP 7.2m relating to reassessment of prior accident years - this NET figure has been used as a fallback. A gross claims development triangle is present but OCR parsing of the triangle in the PDF was incomplete/ambiguous; therefore the gross PYD was not computed from the triangle to avoid misstatement.

_claims_triangle.note: Claims development table present (gross) on page 48 but OCRed values were inconsistent/missing for several cells; development rows omitted here to avoid errors. Use source page 48 for the original triangle.
